source: „Ich stehe früh auf“, sagt Anna. Am Bahnhof wartet sie, bis der Zug um sieben Uhr abfährt.

sentences.text: Am Bahnhof wartet sie, bis der Zug um sieben Uhr abfährt.
sentences.translation: At the station, she waits until the train departs at seven o'clock.

practice_sentences.sentence: Anna sagt, dass der Zug um acht Uhr abfährt.
practice_sentences.translation: Anna says that the train departs at eight o’clock.

practice_sentences.sentence: Der Zug fährt um neun Uhr vom Bahnhof ab.

practice_sentences.sentence: Wir warten am Bahnhof, weil Anna früh kommt.
practice_sentences.translation: We wait at the station because Anna is coming early.

practice_sentences.sentence: Der Zug steht am Bahnhof, und die Uhr zeigt fünf.
practice_sentences.translation: The train is standing at the station, and the clock shows five.

practice_sentences.sentence: Am Bahnhof sagen wir Anna, dass der Zug gleich abfährt.
practice_sentences.translation: At the station, we tell Anna that the train departs soon.

source: Si j’avais su que le train était en retard, je serais venu plus tôt. Au marché, elle achète du pain, puis elle rentre chez elle.

saved.title: Un retard de train et un retour du marché

sentences.text: Si j’avais su que le train était en retard, je serais venu plus tôt.
sentences.translation: If I had known that the train was delayed, I would have come earlier.

sentences.text: Au marché, elle achète du pain, puis elle rentre chez elle.
sentences.translation: At the market, she buys some bread, and then she goes home.

practice_sentences.sentence: Je vais au marché pour acheter du pain, puis je vais rentrer.
practice_sentences.translation: I am going to the market to buy some bread, and then I am going home.

practice_sentences.sentence: J'ai su acheter du pain au marché, puis je suis rentré.
practice_sentences.translation: I knew how to buy some bread at the market, and then I went home.

practice_sentences.sentence: Le train a du retard, donc je ne vais pas être à l'heure.
practice_sentences.translation: The train is delayed, so I am not going to be on time.

practice_sentences.sentence: Nous devons venir plus tôt pour avoir le train.
practice_sentences.translation: We have to come earlier to catch the train.

practice_sentences.sentence: Elle va être au marché pour acheter du pain et avoir du temps.
practice_sentences.translation: She is going to be at the market to buy some bread and have some time.

source: Non vedo l’ora di rivederti. Quando arrivi alla stazione, chiamami prima di comprare il biglietto.

sentences.translation: I can’t wait to see you again.

sentences.text: Quando arrivi alla stazione, chiamami prima di comprare il biglietto.
sentences.translation: When you arrive at the station, call me before buying the ticket.

practice_sentences.sentence: Prima di arrivare alla stazione, devo comprare un biglietto.
practice_sentences.translation: Before arriving at the station, I have to buy a ticket.

practice_sentences.sentence: Ora devo chiamare Marta, perché voglio rivedere un amico alla stazione.
practice_sentences.translation: Now I have to call Marta because I want to see a friend again at the station.

practice_sentences.sentence: Vorrei vedere il paesaggio dalla finestra del treno, prima che arrivi alla stazione.
practice_sentences.translation: I would like to see the landscape from the train window before it arrives at the station.

practice_sentences.sentence: Il biglietto che compro alla stazione mi permette di vedere il treno in arrivo.
practice_sentences.translation: The ticket I buy at the station allows me to see the arriving train.

practice_sentences.sentence: Ora devo chiamare la stazione per rivedere gli orari e sapere quando deve arrivare il treno.
practice_sentences.translation: Now I have to call the station to check the timetables and find out when the train is due to arrive.
